A '''mess hall''' was located in [[Arda Base]]. Along with the rest of the base, it was abandoned after an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] attack.<ref name="OAA1" />

The hall contained four tables and a number of stackable chairs. At night, the mess hall was converted into a bar that was tended by [[Urel Haydon]].<ref name="OAA1" />
